title: Generation of AGM-derived Akt-EC (AGM-EC)
protocol: Set up timed matings of C56BL/6J mice to generate embryos at the desired age.
Harvest embryos from pregnant females at 9.5 to 11.5 days post coitum (dpc).
Dissect the AGM region from the embryos in ice-cold PBS with 10% FBS.
Collect dissected AGMs into a 15ml conical tube containing 10 ml of PBS with 10% FBS on ice.
Gravity settle tissues and gently remove the PBS/FBS solution.
Add 1ml of 0.25% collagenase to the settled tissues.
Incubate in a 37°C water bath for 25 minutes.
Add 1 ml of PBS/10% FBS after incubation with collagenase.
Pipette about 20-30 times with a 1ml pipette tip to obtain a single cell suspension.
Add an additional 8 ml of PBS/10% FBS and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Prepare blocking buffer by adding anti mouse CD16/CD32 Fc receptor (FcR) block and DAPI to PBS with 10% FBS.
Draw the prepared blocking buffer into a 3 ml syringe and pass through a 0.22-micron filter for sterilization.
Re-suspend the cell pellet from dissociated embryonic tissues in 0.5 ml of blocking buffer.
Incubate the re-suspended cells on ice for 5 minutes.
Prepare antibody mix: add 10 microgram/ml FcR block to 1 ml PBS with 10% FBS.
Add 10 microliters of each fluorochrome-conjugated VE-cadherin, CD41, CD45, and Ter119 antibodies to the mixture.
Draw antibody mix into a 3 ml syringe and pass through a 0.22-micron filter to sterilize.
Add 0.5ml antibody mix to cell pellet in blocking buffer from above.
Incubate on ice for at least 20 minutes.
Add 9 ml PBS/10% FBS and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Again, add 10 ml PBS/10% FBS and centrifuge at 300 x g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Resuspend the pellet with 0.5ml PBS/10% FBS.
Remove cell clumps by pipetting the cell suspension through a 35-micron cell strainer cap on a 5 ml tube.
Perform fluorescent activated cell sorting (FACS) by first gating SSC and FSC using relatively broad gates as embryonic EC tend to vary in size.
Gate live cells as DAPI negative.
Gate cells positive for VE-cadherin, and negative for CD41, CD45, and Ter119 to minimize contamination from hematopoietic populations.
Use isotype control antibodies to determine thresholds for setting gates for sorting.
Set the sorting machine to the lowest flow rate of 1.0 to avoid excess shear stress on the sorted EC.
Sort cells into a 5mL tube containing cold PBS/10% FBS.
Add 0.25 ml Retronectin (5 micrograms/ml in PBS) to individual wells of 48-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate the plates at 4°C overnight.
Remove retronectin solution from wells and wash with 0.5 ml PBS.
Do not let well dry after washing.
Add 0.5 ml cells resuspended in AGM-EC+ media (2 x 10^5 cells/ml) to each well.
Culture ECs with AGM-EC+ media for 1-2 days in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2.
Remove media from wells of ECs and add fresh AGM-EC+ media on day 1-2 if necessary.
Infect sub-confluent ECs with PGK.myr-AKT lentivirus when cells cover 50-75% of the plastic bottom.
Thaw stored viral supernatant in ice immediately before use.
Remove media from wells of ECs and add 0.35 ml AGM EC+ media + virus mixture to each well.
Add 0.5 microliters protamine sulfate (4 mg/ml [4 micrograms/ml final]) to the viral supernatant.
Add 0.15 ml viral supernatant to one well of a plate.
Incubate the added viral supernatant in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Remove media containing virus and replace with 0.5 ml AGM EC media (base media without additives).
Culture for 1-2 days in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2 until cell layer evenly covers the bottom of the well (confluent).
Add 1 ml 0.1% gelatin to one well of a 12 well plate and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Aspirate gelatin solution from the 12 well plate and leave the plate in a tissue culture hood with the lid removed until the wells are dry.
Dissociate cells in the 48 well by adding 0.2 ml TrypLE solution.
Incubate dissociated cells in a 37°C tissue culture incubator for 3-5 min until cells are detached.
Pipette detached cells to a 15 ml conical tube and add 9 ml AGM-EC media.
Centrifuge cells at 300 g for 5 min, aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 ml AGM-EC media.
Plate the resuspended cell suspension in one gelatinized well of a 12 well plate.
Culture plated cells in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2.
Transfer confluent cells from 12-well plates to one well of a 6-well plate using the trypsinization procedure.
Culture cells in the 6-well plate until they are confluent, then transfer them to a T25 tissue culture flask and culture until confluent again.
Transfer confluent cells from the T25 flask to a T75 tissue culture flask for further culturing.
Reserve 4X10^4 cells for serum-free viability testing in step 4 below.
Plate 4X10^4 AGM Akt ECs into one gelatinized well of a 24-well plate with AGM EC media.
Culture the plated AGM Akt ECs in a 37°C tissue culture incubator with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Aspirate AGM EC media from the well and replace it with X-Vivo 20 serum-free media.
Replace the AGM EC media with X-Vivo 20 media in the well containing mock-infected cells.
Monitor the EC monolayer in the well containing AGM Akt-EC to ensure it remains intact/confluent for at least 7 days under serum-free conditions.
Maintain cells in T75 tissue culture flasks.
Dissociate confluent layer with TrypLE once the layer is confluent every 4-7 days.
Estimate cell number using a hemocytometer.
Replate 5x10^5 cells to each gelatinized T75 flask.
Phenotype AGM Akt EC cells with flow cytometry to assess EC purity using EC-specific antibodies including: VE-Cadherin, Flk1, and CD31.
Freeze AGM Akt EC in 90% FBS/10% DMSO at the earliest passage when sufficient numbers have been generated.
Store frozen cells containing approximately 1 x 10^6 cells/vial in liquid nitrogen.
Thaw cryogenic vials containing frozen AGM Akt EC cells in a 37°C water bath.
Remove cells from cryogenic vial immediately after thawing and add to 10 mL EC media to wash.
Centrifuge cells at 300g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the pellet in EC media.
Plate the resuspended cell suspension onto gelatinized T75 flask.
